skonester_cheat_menu.1150 = {
  type = character_event
  title = skonester_cheat_menu.craft_mod_stack.t
  desc = skonester_cheat_menu.craft_mod_stack.desc
  theme = default

  option = {
    name = skonester_cheat_menu.craft_mod_stack.m1_plus
    scope:actor = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable =
    skonester_craft_m1_cnt } }
    set_variable = { name =
    skonester_craft_m1_cnt value = 1 } }
    change_variable = { name =
    skonester_craft_m1_cnt add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { var:skonester_craft_m1_cnt > 999 } }
    set_variable = { name =
    skonester_craft_m1_cnt value = 999 } }
    trigger_event = skonester_cheat_menu.0030
  }
  option = {
    name = skonester_cheat_menu.craft_mod_stack.m1_minus
    scope:actor = {
    if = { limit = { var:skonester_craft_m1_cnt > 1 } }
    change_variable = { name =
    skonester_craft_m1_cnt add = -1 } }
    trigger_event = skonester_cheat_menu.0030
